manuscript_policy.source: §2.4.3 Federated Training Protocol (manuscript p.17-18); Table 3 'Val. AUC plateau'
manuscript_policy.text: After each communication round, mean validation AUC across tasks was computed; training was halted when this value did not improve over 15 consecutive rounds (patience = 15). A maximum of 100 rounds was enforced as a hard ceiling. The model state from the best validation round was retained for evaluation.

checkpoint_filename_pattern.best_{model_name}_seed{seed}.pt: saved on best validation IHM AUROC (train.py), every run
checkpoint_filename_pattern.bestmean_{model_name}_seed{seed}.pt: saved on best mean validation AUROC over active tasks (added in 98c896a, revision only)

before_fix.metric_used_for_selection: IHM validation AUROC for the checkpoint every manuscript evaluator loaded; early stopping on mean AUROC (at 942a1bc: precision-weighted mean when uncertainty weighting was on, see P0 Decision 4)
before_fix.round_selected: best-IHM round; can differ from the logged best_round (best mean-AUROC round)
deviations: All manuscript evaluators and attacks (evaluate_test, evaluate_test_dp, evaluate_test_ablations_dp, evaluate_exp2, evaluate_exp3, evaluate_ablations, calibration_predictions, ablations_dp label inference, label_inference, embedding_mia, feature_reconstruction) loaded best_* = best IHM AUROC, not best mean AUROC.
privacy_utility_curves.py default patience=0 (no early stopping, always 100 rounds) vs manuscript patience 15.

run_exp2.py saved exp3_{config} but evaluate_exp2.py loaded exp2_{config}; run_exp3.py saved exp4_sites{n} but evaluate_exp3.py loaded exp3_sites{n}: evaluators could not find the training checkpoints under current code.

feature_reconstruction.py built DP names without the _seed{N} suffix that training writes, so the canonical file never matched and a glob fallback loaded any *seed{N}*.pt (eps-matching or most recent) - possibly the wrong model.

after_fix.metric_used_for_selection: plain mean validation AUROC over the tasks with nonzero weight (single-task runs: that task's AUROC); identical for equal and uncertainty weighting
after_fix.round_selected: best_round column in every results row = round of the saved checkpoint (checkpoint stores 'round'); revision evaluator additionally asserts checkpoint round == best_round
after_fix.patience: 15 in every VFL training script (privacy_utility_curves.py default changed 0 -> 15)
files_changed: train.py (removed best-IHM checkpoint; single bestmean checkpoint)
attacks/feature_reconstruction.py (correct DP name, glob fallback removed)

verification.synthetic_end_to_end: run_training (6 rounds) wrote exactly one file bestmean_VFL-MTL_seed42.pt; its stored round == logged best_round == argmax of mean val AUROC; evaluate_test.eval_vfl_mtl loaded it
verification.tests: pytest tests/ and smoke_tests/_regression_check.py pass; no files written outside smoke_tests/

not_changed.train.py main() CLI: standalone README entry point, not used by any manuscript experiment or SLURM job; keeps best_seed{N}.pt on IHM AUROC with no early stopping

baselines.centralized.py: selects on mean of IHM/Decomp/Pheno val AUROC (matches the rule); best_centralized_seed{N}.pt; patience changed 10 -> 15 (see decision)
baselines.local_only.py: selects on its own task's val AUROC (= mean over its single task); best_local_{site}_seed{N}.pt; patience changed 10 -> 15 (see decision)

consequences_for_other_tasks.T12: With patience 15 a DP run can stop before 100 rounds, so epsilon spent can be below the target epsilon used to calibrate sigma; report epsilon actually spent (logged per round) alongside the target.
consequences_for_other_tasks.T17: Manuscript results were evaluated on best-IHM checkpoints; corrected results use the best mean-AUC checkpoint the Methods already describe.

decision.question: Baselines (centralized, local-only) used patience 10; VFL uses 15. Align baselines to 15?

options.A: Set baseline patience to 15 (same stopping rule for every model compared in the paper).
options.B: Keep 10 and state it in the Methods/Table 3.
